appDescription.message: Manually zoom video to remove the black bars and fill an ultrawide 21:9 or 32:9 screen. Local only, no data collection.

intro.message: Enlarge video while keeping its proportions.

fitHint.message: Go fullscreen first, then use Fill the frame: it calculates the zoom that makes the picture span the player, from the video size alone.

fitUnavailable.message: Fill the frame is unavailable: the picture already spans the player, or its size is not known yet.

noVideo.message: No video found. Start playback to apply zoom.

notEnabled.message: Not enabled on this page yet.

notEnabledNote.message: This extension only reaches sites you allow. Turning it on here keeps working after a reload.

permissionDenied.message: Not enabled: permission was not granted.

unsupportedPage.message: Extensions cannot run on this kind of page.

tabError.message: Could not connect to this tab.

storageNote.message: Zoom is saved on this device for this site. Enlarging crops the edges of the picture.

accessNote.message: The sites listed below work straight away. Anywhere else, allow the site once from this popup and it keeps working. Review or remove access in chrome://extensions under Details, Site access.

sites.message: Sites: Netflix, U-NEXT, Hulu (Japan/US), YouTube, Disney+, Prime Video (including Amazon JP/US video pages), Apple TV, ABEMA, TVer.
